title_en: Every Nintendo Switch 2 Game Confirmed for 2026
body_en:
We now have our hands on the Nintendo Switch 2 , a new console from one of the biggest names in gaming. Alas, a new console is only as valuable as the library of games you can build on it.
Thankfully, Nintendo hasn't been shy about planned releases over the next year. In the second half of 2026, we'll be getting our hands on a mix of Switch 2 exclusives, third-party releases, and the benefit of backward compatibility with any games still launching on the original Switch. Without further ado, here are all of the new Switch 2 games we can look forward to in 2026 and beyond.
RuneScape got a bit of a makeover with this new open world crafting and survival game that was initially released last year, and is finally coming to Switch 2 this fall.
We finally have a release date for the next game in the Fire Emblem series, which already happens to be available to preorder . Here’s a snippet of what to expect from the official Nintendo listing : “Worthy fighters from all over the land have come to Dagsion, the capital city of the Dagdan Empire, to compete in the Heroic Games for the chance to win one wish. Among the combatants are four heroes tied to the fate of the world.” You can learn more about how the game balances those four heroes in our hands-on preview .
If you’re looking for a cozy platformer you can play with a friend, Trine 6 might have you covered. The latest side-scrolling sequel from FrozenByte is designed with co-op in mind, so you can test your friendship on movement combos and puzzles.
From Masato Kato, the writer behind Chrono Trigger, comes Another Eden Begins, a completely fresh RPG that takes you on a journey across the past, present, and future. Recruit companions from a roster of 18 characters to help you take down the Beast King and find your sister. This one’s got a whopping 10 endings on the menu, though I’m sure some of those are reserved for New Game+.
The latest LEGO game finally has a Switch 2 release date. LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is truly next level . It blends and parodies classic Batman moments from across all iterations of the caped crusader while also offering a pretty massive plastic version of Arkham to play around in. Even the combat is pretty elaborate, with inspiration from the Arkham games courtesy of development support from Rocksteady Studios.
SEGA brought back its Shinobi series with the action platformer Art of Vengeance in 2025. We called the new release “a genuinely engaging 2D action platformer that’s beautiful to behold and even better to play” in our review , and it’ll be getting a Switch 2 port later this year.
We called the first Minecraft Dungeons game a “fun dungeon crawler with a simple but tried-and-true set of systems.” The sequel, developed by Mojang and published by Xbox, will be launching across platforms, including Switch 2, this September . Like the first game, the block-based dungeon crawler will support both local and online multiplayer.
After announcing The Witcher 4 , which is reportedly targeting a 2028 release , CD Projekt Red also announced a massive remaster of its 2015 masterpiece , The Witcher 3. The remaster is free for anyone who already owns the game on PC or any console, including a free Switch 2 upgrade coming later this month.
Yet another massive multi-platform release, IO Interactive's take on James Bond is launching on Switch 2 several months after its initial release on PC, PS5, and Xbox in late May. The game lets you play out Bond's initial recruitment and rise in the MI6 ranks, featuring Patrick Gibson as the titular spy and Lenny Kravitz as the villain Bawma .
Following the release of Octopath Traveler 0 , Square Enix is releasing fresh Switch 2 editions of the original two games that defined the HD-2D style. We were big fans of both, for what it’s worth, with IGN’s Seth Macy praising how the first game “pushes JRPGs forward rather than simply paying homage to the greats” in his 9/10 review .
Remakes truly are all the rage right now. This one is a 3D reimagining of 2013’s Rayman Legends, which we called a “work of platforming genius” in our original 9.5/10 review .
The Switch 2 will be getting fresh editions of existing Kingdom Hearts games, which will replace the existing ‘ Cloud streaming’ versions that were available on the Switch. Those Cloud versions were notoriously… not great, so here’s to hoping this gives everyone a better shot at the series ahead of Kingdom Hearts 4 . The three collections will be available individually or as one big bundle.
Hell is Us, from studio Rogue Factor, was originally released almost exactly year ago. In the words of our review , the game “has a blend of exploration, puzzles, and combat that, while familiar, pushes you to really pay attention to the world around you in a way that’s both compelling and occasionally frustrating."
Capcom’s RPG sequel is getting a new ‘Dark Arisen’ edition with fresh content and QOL improvements as it launches on the Switch 2. Jarrett Green reviewed the game for IGN when it was first released on PC, saying that it’s more than anything “a retelling and reimplementation of… wonderful ideas from the 2012 cult-classic.”
For the cozy gamers, The Witch’s Bakery places you in control of Lunne, a young witch who’s opening a new bakery in Paris. In the vein of something like Dave the Diver, each in-game day is split into multiple phases of managing your bakery and exploring the town while also using your magic to help your friends.
The first 2D Castlevania game in almost 20 years narratively follows Castlevania 3: Dracula’s Curse, taking place a little over decade after that one’s story (which also serves as inspiration for the animated Netflix series). Mitchell Saltzman got the chance to preview the game for IGN , with particular praise for the combat, saying there’s “plenty of room to carve out your own personal playstyle thanks to the variety of weapons, Arcana, and relics.”
Tales of Eternia is getting a remake and returning to its original title. Previously localized as Tales of Destiny II in North America, Eternia was first released for the PS2 back in the 2000 as the third game in Namco’s Tales series.
In the tradition of what I consider some all-time greats, Wii Sports and Wii Sports Resort, Nintendo recently announced Nintendo Switch Sports: Resort . The Switch 2 exclusive will feature 12 sports, a mix of classics like bowling and tennis as well as new sports like thumb wrestling, that use a combination of the Switch 2’s motion and mouse controls.
This new Final Fantasy game technically adapts the FF mobile game Brave Exvius that was discontinued in 2025. More notably, however, it’s the first Final Fantasy game to embrace the new HD-2D graphics system popularized by modern classics like Octopath Traveler.
IGN’s own Michael Higham got the chance to check out the first couple of hours of gameplay, so you can learn more about how this one blends new and old Final Fantasy traditions in our hands-on preview .
Yep, it’s a One Piece cooking game. This one feels like a real throwback to the glory days of Flash games, which I deeply appreciate. The management sim puts you in charge of a restaurant, going on expeditions to acquire new ingredients and recipes while encountering over 400 characters from one of the greatest manga (and anime) series of all time.
Yep, it’s that time of year. For the next CoD release, Activision is following up the return to Black Ops by bringing us back to the Modern Warfare series. Yep, that means the return of iconic characters like Ghost . It’s not all nostalgia, though, with plenty of new additions like an extraction game mode called DMZ . You can learn more about what to expect from the shooter sequel in our interview with Infinity Ward .
This third-person action shooter puts you in control of 17-year-old Reona Minazuki, a professional ‘Diver’ that explores deadly ‘Anomaly Zones’ for the government while searching for her lost friend. The Steam listing offers the rather interesting description that the game is “steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics.”
Not too long after we got our hands on Hello Kitty Island Adventure, the iconic Sanrio character is returning for yet another cute and cozy game. This one is a party game in the tradition of classics like Mario Party, featuring more than 40 minigames and over 140 Sanrio characters.
If you’re familiar with Steins;Gate, potentially one of the most acclaimed anime of all time, you might be aware that it’s actually based on a visual novel dating back to 2009. That visual novel is getting the good old remake treatment , which will include the addition of new endings.
Now this is a big one. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was announced earlier this year before getting an entire Nintendo Direct dedicated to it , showing off revamped graphics, gameplay, and camera controls. The Switch 2 exclusive still seeks to retain the magic of the original, including some funky character designs .
Pikmin 4 originally launched on the Switch back in 2023, and we were pretty big fans. Jada Griffin praised “all-new features like ability upgrades, a pair of new Pikmin, and our loyal sidekick Oatchi” in her 9/10 review . Like previous Switch 2 editions , it’ll be coming to the newer console with a fresh expansion : Dandori Academy.
Metaphor Re:Fantazio (November 12, 2026)
This new IP from Atlus, best known for the SMT and Persona series, features similar mechanics around turn-based combat and social links. Instead of playing as a high schooler, though, you take on the role of Will, a young man who seeks to bring justice to a fantasy world facing its first version of an election. We gave the game a solid 9/10 when it first dropped on PC, and it even landed as our top RPG of 2024 .
This collection will come with 16 classic Barbie games that were originally released between 1991 and 2007, as well as one unreleased game, Barbie: Vacation Adventure. Funnily enough, this happens to be one of the only games daring enough to announce a release date in the November crossfires of GTA 6 .
The rogue-like classic we called “non-stop fun” is making its way to Switch 2 with a fully packed Repentance+ edition, which includes all released expansions.
In the lead-up to Xenoblade Genesis, an entirely new game in DADSS’s iconic RPG series, Xenoblade Chronicles 3 is getting the Switch 2 edition treatment. The port will also be available as a digital upgrade pack for anyone who already owns the game. IGN’s reviewer tackled the 150-hour campaign , which he considered worth the time for “great characters and addictive tactical combat.”
A new addition to the monster-taming Dragon Quest spin-off series is coming to Switch 2 this December. The RPG will star two protagonists, Bianca and Nera, who are trying to find a cure for their fathers. The girls end up in the Kingdom of Witherwood, where you can catch, train, and battle with some adorable monsters.
We said the latest mainline Monster Hunter game features “some extremely fun fights,” and the boss-focused action game is getting a Switch 2 port this Winter. The upcoming expansion Ascendance will also be making its way to the Switch 2 at some point next year.
The next puzzle-focused Professor Layton game from Level-5 finally has a release date. The story takes place around one year after the events of Unwound Future, taking the professor and Luke to the steampunk-inspired town of Steam Bison. This will be the first Professor Layton game to launch on PlayStation and PC .
Danganronpa is coming back. This upcoming visual novel combines a remake of Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair with a new game mode, Slayhem, which features the same characters but with new scenarios for you to help solve.
Following up on Metroid Prime 4: Beyond , MercurySteam has announced a new 2D side-scroller starring the iconic Samus. The game is seemingly a follow-up to Metroid Dread, which we said merges “legendary exploration and progression” with “excellent modern combat and some of the best boss fights ever," in our original 9/10 review .
Crystal Dynamics is remaking Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis from the ground up, and the new version of Lara Croft’s debut adventure will be playable on Switch 2 at launch. You can learn more about what's changed from the original 1996 game in our hands-on preview .
For folks who prefer battling with decks, this remake of Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 will feature modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.
This turn-based JRPG originally launched on the Super Famicom all the way back in 1995. Now, 30 years later, Square Enix has announced a 3D remake that will include new gameplay and full voice-acting.
This entirely new game from studio Marvelous is being pitched as a “love letter to JRPGs,” featuring some classic turn-based combat and tons of classes and abilities. The game will also feature some good ol’ time travel as well as a unique “Future Sight” mechanic.
We officially have a release date for the third and final part of Square Enix’s FF7 remake. Titled Revelation, the final arc of the trilogy will pick up immediately after Rebirth, with Cloud and co. working to stop Sephiroth. Aside from the continued revamped graphics, the third remake will introduce even more battle customization . Square Enix has also confirmed that the game will receive two new expansions : Story DLC 1: Sephiroth and Story DLC 2: Vincent & the Turks.
Before we get our hands on Persona 6 , Atlus is dropping yet another remake in its iconic Persona series . Persona 4 will be getting a similar treatment to what we saw with Persona 5 Royal and Persona 3 Reload , with remastered graphics, refined turn-based combat, and, potentially, additional storylines and social links.
There are plenty more Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 games in development that don’t have a solid release date yet. Here are some more games we know are on the way, including the highly-anticipated 10th generation of Pokémon :
Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.
